name: PakGroundnut-4V
description: Overview PakGroundnut-4V is a large-scale, multi-condition image dataset built for Pakistani groundnut (Arachis hypogaea L.) variety classification research. It contains 8,944 JPEG images spanning four expert-verified varieties, each photographed under five backgrounds, four lighting conditions, and five quantity levels (1–5 peanuts per frame) from a fixed 90° overhead angle. Images were collected across two sites in Punjab, Pakistan, producing a controlled yet diverse benchmark suited to both standard classification and domain-generalization research. The release is supplemented by 60 negative-class background images and 80 morphometric pod measurements for cross-referencing visual and physical variety traits. Variety identity was established through dual verification: peer-reviewed literature and direct expert consultation with the Barani Agricultural Research Institute (BARI), Chakwal. PakGroundnut-4V is released under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license, allowing free reuse, adaptation, and commercial use with attribution.
